description: PRD-205 — Tenant Resolution Consolidation. Collapse the 7 divergent tenant-resolution helpers (lib/tenant.ts x5, lib/resolve-tenant-id.ts, the drgreen webhook route-local resolveTenant) plus the duplicate host derivation in middleware.ts into ONE canonical resolveTenant(input) in lib/tenant-resolver.ts. The canonical resolver RETURNS {tenantId, tenant} | null (never binds the ALS — PRD-202 owns binding), enforces isActive on every kind, returns a typed AmbiguousTenantResolution for multi-tenant email instead of a silent first-row pick, and shares one parseHostToTenantHint with middleware. Every other helper becomes a thin delegator. STACKED on the ralph/prd-202 branch (strict dependency: resolver must return-not-bind).

userStories.title: Shared host parser lib/parse-host.ts parseHostToTenantHint(host) (AC-2a)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one host-parsing utility that maps a request host to a tenant hint (subdomain | customDomain | null) so middleware.ts and the canonical resolver cannot drift.
acceptanceCriteria: New lib/parse-host.ts exports parseHostToTenantHint(host: string): { kind: 'subdomain'; subdomain: string } | { kind: 'customDomain'; host: string } | null

Lifts the existing apex / multi-part-TLD handling (OQ-3, commit 6d6a381 / current middleware.ts + getTenantFromRequest logic) — strips port, treats www as no-subdomain, ignores localhost/127.0.0.1, uses NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_DOMAIN (default budstacks.io) to split slug.<base> subdomains from apex custom domains
Pure function — no DB, no headers(), no ALS; deterministic for a given host + base domain

Unit tests (tests/unit/parse-host.test.ts): slug.budstacks.io -> subdomain; apex custom domain -> customDomain; www.budstacks.io -> null; localhost/127.0.0.1 -> null; host:port stripped; base domain itself -> null
Tests pass

Returns Promise<{ tenantId: string; tenant: Tenant } | null>; an email matching >1 active tenant returns a typed AmbiguousTenantResolution (exported) instead of a silent first-row pick (AC-1b)

headers kind reads x-tenant-slug then x-tenant-subdomain then x-tenant-custom-domain (preserving getCurrentTenant precedence); host kind uses parseHostToTenantHint + the /store/{slug} path match; clerk kind prefers the clerkOrgId->settings match over the email fallback
RETURN-not-bind: the resolver makes ZERO setTenantContext/enterWith calls (AC-1a)

getTenantBySlug(slug) delegates to resolveTenant({ kind: 'slug', slug }) (lower-case retry now lives in the canonical resolver)
getTenantFromRequest(req) delegates to resolveTenant({ kind: 'host', host, pathname }) — its bespoke host/subdomain/customDomain parsing is deleted in favour of the shared util
